geometry.coordinates: lighthouse origin, land x <= shore(y), sea x > shore(y)

constraints: Compose actual separate raster sprites and masks; do not use a flattened generated gameplay scene.
No sky, horizon, moon, UI, text, enemies, devices or directed combat beam in this clean field reference.
World positions and the coast are identical in both views. Fit the entire active worldRadius into portrait; never crop away the marine half.
Lighthouse near center, on land; keep the active area mostly clear. High decorative ruins live outside the active disk.
Cold blue/slate sea and stone, muted dark vegetation, amber windows; match existing sprites/background.png pixel scale and materials.
Use nearest-neighbor scaling. Full art is a design reference; no live placement, movement or saves are changed.
